basics.name: William Costa
basics.label: DevOps Engineer
basics.summary: DevOps engineer with 2 years experience building pipelines.

work.name: Delta Systems
work.summary: Designed and maintained CI/CD infrastructure and container orchestration platform for a microservices product running on Kubernetes.
highlights: Migrated 12 services from manual deployments to fully automated GitLab CI/CD pipelines
Reduced deployment time from 45 minutes to under 8 minutes through pipeline parallelisation
Provisioned and maintained a 40-node Kubernetes cluster serving 3 environments
Standardised service packaging with Helm charts, cutting new service onboarding from days to hours

technologies.name: GitLab
technologies.purpose: CI/CD pipelines for build, test, and deploy across all services
technologies.rationale: Self-hosted GitLab provided tight integration with the existing source repositories and allowed pipeline customisation without a separate CI vendor

technologies.name: Kubernetes
technologies.purpose: Container orchestration for all production and staging workloads
technologies.rationale: Needed automated scaling, self-healing, and rolling updates; Kubernetes was already the company standard across all teams

technologies.name: Docker
technologies.purpose: Containerisation of all services and build environments
technologies.rationale: Eliminated environment drift between local development and production; multi-stage builds reduced final image sizes by 60%

technologies.name: Helm
technologies.purpose: Kubernetes package manager for templating and versioning deployment manifests
technologies.rationale: Helm charts allowed per-environment value overrides without duplicating manifests; chart versioning enabled reliable rollbacks

technologies.name: Ansible
technologies.purpose: Configuration management and provisioning of cluster nodes and base infrastructure
technologies.rationale: Idempotent playbooks made node reprovisioning safe and repeatable; no agent required simplified the security model

work.name: Acme Corp
work.summary: Led backend platform work for a data-intensive SaaS product serving 50k daily active users.
highlights: Built event-driven pipeline handling 10k msg/s with 99.95% uptime
Reduced p99 latency by 40% through query optimisation and caching
Mentored 3 junior engineers and led bi-weekly architecture reviews

technologies.name: Python
technologies.purpose: Core language for the ETL pipeline and REST API services
technologies.rationale: Chosen for its rich data ecosystem (pandas, SQLAlchemy) and strong team familiarity, enabling fast iteration

technologies.name: PostgreSQL
technologies.purpose: Primary data store for user accounts, transactions, and audit logs
technologies.rationale: Required ACID compliance and complex join support for financial data integrity; existing team expertise reduced onboarding time

technologies.name: Kafka
technologies.purpose: Event bus for decoupling microservices and handling real-time data ingestion
technologies.rationale: Needed durable, ordered message delivery at scale without operating a custom broker; log compaction simplified state reconstruction

technologies.name: Redis
technologies.rationale: Sub-millisecond reads solved the latency bottleneck in auth middleware; atomic operations simplified the rate-limit implementation

technologies.name: Docker
technologies.purpose: Containerisation of all services for consistent dev and prod environments
technologies.rationale: Eliminated environment drift between developer machines and CI; simplified Kubernetes deployment manifests

work.name: Beta Inc
work.summary: Built and maintained a customer-facing React dashboard and the Node.js backend that powered it.
highlights: Delivered dashboard redesign that increased user retention by 18%
Migrated monolith to service-oriented architecture over 6 months with zero downtime
Introduced automated testing, raising coverage from 12% to 74%

technologies.name: React
technologies.purpose: Primary UI framework for the customer dashboard
technologies.rationale: Component model matched the design system structure; large ecosystem of chart and table libraries reduced build time

technologies.name: TypeScript
technologies.purpose: Static typing across frontend and shared API contracts
technologies.rationale: Caught a class of runtime errors at compile time; shared types between frontend and backend eliminated contract drift

technologies.name: Node.js
technologies.purpose: REST API and WebSocket server for the dashboard backend
technologies.rationale: Shared language with the frontend team reduced context switching; non-blocking I/O handled concurrent WebSocket connections efficiently

technologies.name: PostgreSQL
technologies.purpose: Relational store for customer data, events, and billing records
technologies.rationale: Consistent choice with company standards; JSONB columns provided flexibility for semi-structured event payloads without a separate document store

work.name: Gamma Studio
work.summary: Developed features for a content management platform used by media companies.
highlights: Built a drag-and-drop page builder component used by 200+ clients
Optimised image delivery pipeline, cutting average page load by 1.2s

technologies.name: Vue.js
technologies.purpose: UI framework for the page builder and CMS editor interface
technologies.rationale: Gentler learning curve than React for a junior team; two-way data binding simplified form-heavy CMS workflows

technologies.name: PHP
technologies.rationale: Existing codebase was PHP/Laravel; contributed within established patterns while learning backend fundamentals

technologies.name: MySQL
technologies.rationale: Standard choice within the Laravel ecosystem; existing DBA expertise in the team
